messages.subject: Amazon Research Scientist Position
parts:
David Afshartous writes, "My team at Amazon has an opening for a PhD statistician (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/421873). We are within Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), the department that hosted the Amazon Research Science summit that you attended last year. Essentially, my team runs randomized controlled trials on Amazon’s supply chain to drive inventory management innovation. Statistical challenges include big data, heavy tails, zero inflation, and interim testing, to name a few."

You can apply for the job directly--I (Andrew) know nothing about it beyond the above announcement. It does seem like a good place to use Stan.
